title: Antes de Ir para Casa
summary: Kairos holds its early Thanksgiving gathering, releases players for a four-day family break, and collects anonymous appreciation cards.
keyEvents: Training is reduced; no afternoon scrims or reviews occur.
All five competitive teams, staff, and visiting families share an early Thanksgiving dinner.
Players are released to visit family and expected back Monday after a four-day break.
Anonymous appreciation cards are collected and later delivered privately.
